description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Finance Executive with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting**, including general accounting, GST compliance and filing, TDS, and financial record management. * Manage day-to-day accounting operations independently using Tally ERP/Tally Prime.
* Handle GST-related activities, including GST data preparation, reconciliation, return preparation, and GST return filing.
* Manage TDS-related activities, including calculation, deduction, payment coordination, reconciliation, and TDS return filing.
* Perform bank, vendor, customer, and inter-account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice verification, payment tracking, and outstanding follow-ups.
* Verify invoices, vouchers, expense claims, and supporting documents to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Conduct ledger scrutiny and ensure proper classification and recording of financial transactions.
* Prepare monthly financial reports, account statements, and other financial summaries as required.
* Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities and ensure timely completion of accounting records.
* Maintain proper documentation for GST, TDS, audits, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors, customers, internal departments, and external auditors on accounting and finance-related matters.
* Support statutory audits by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and relevant financial documents.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, taxation regulations, and statutory deadlines.
* Perform other accounting and finance-related duties as assigned by management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* **Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting.**
* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles and complete bookkeeping processes.
* Practical experience in **GST preparation, reconciliation, and return filing**.
* Good working knowledge of **TDS calculation, deduction, payment, reconciliation, and return filing**.
* **Strong proficiency in Tally ERP/Tally Prime** is essential.
* Experience in bank reconciliation, ledger scrutiny, invoice verification, and financial record maintenance.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.

* Strong analytical skills, numerical accuracy, and attention to detail.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates who have independently handled complete accounting operations, including GST and TDS compliance.

title: Banking Executive/Treasury Accountant
description:
**Purpose of the role**  
The Banking Executive keeps the company's bank and cash records accurate every day. The role owns daily bank reconciliations, timely posting of customer collections, and a control review of vendor payments before release. It is a key support to month-end close, audit and cash reporting.

**Key responsibilities**

* Daily bank reconciliation
* Download bank statements for all operating, escrow and collection accounts daily.
* Reconcile bank balances to the general ledger and clear matched items in the ERP.
* Investigate and resolve unreconciled items, unidentified receipts and bank charges within agreed timelines.
* Maintain an ageing of reconciling items and escalate long-outstanding entries.
* Prepare month-end bank reconciliation statements with supporting documents for review and audit.

**Collection entries**

* Record customer receipts (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS, UPI, cheques, PDCs, card payments) daily against the correct customer and invoice.
* Identify and allocate unidentified receipts with the sales / CRM team.

**Vendor payment review**

* Verify vendor bank details against the vendor master and flag any changes for validation.
* Prepare the daily cash position and short-term cash flow forecast.
* Manage bank relationships: account opening, signatory updates, guarantees and LC documentation.
* Book bank charges, interest and FX differences.
* Support month-end close, MIS reporting and internal / external audit requests.
* Maintain filing of banking documents and follow internal controls and policies.
* Handle ad-hoc tasks assigned by the Finance Manager.

**Qualifications and skills**

**Must Have**

**Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting or Finance.**

* 1–3 years in banking operations, treasury or accounts in India.
* Hands-on experience with daily bank reconciliations and receipt posting.
* Working knowledge of an ERP (SAP, Oracle, Tally or similar) and corporate net-banking portals.
* Advanced Excel: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliation templates.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and Indian accounting standards (Ind AS).

**Preferred**

* Real estate or property development sector experience, including escrow accounts.
* Part-qualified CA, ACCA or CMA.

**Personal attributes**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong sense of ownership and ability to meet daily deadlines.
* Clear communication with banks, vendors and internal teams.
* Integrity and discretion with confidential financial data.

title: Accounting Lab Faculty
description:
Job Description: Accounting Lab Faculty

**Job Title:** Accounting Lab Faculty  
**Department:** Academics / Practical Training  
**Reporting To:** Academic Head / Centre Manager  
**Experience Required:** 1–3 Years (Freshers with strong practical knowledge may apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Thrissur  
**Salary:** 12,000-20,000

1. Job Summary

We are seeking a knowledgeable, patient, and student-oriented Accounting Lab Faculty member to conduct practical accounting training and support students in developing hands-on skills in accounting software and financial operations.

The candidate will be responsible for guiding students through practical accounting exercises, assisting them with software-based assignments, monitoring their lab activities, evaluating their performance, and ensuring they gain the practical knowledge required for accounting and finance-related jobs.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical accounting knowledge, proficiency in accounting software, good communication skills, and the ability to guide students effectively in a computer lab environment.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Practical Accounting Training

* Conduct practical lab sessions based on accounting concepts and industry requirements.
* Guide students in journal entries, ledger posting, trial balance preparation, bank reconciliation, and financial statement preparation.
* Provide hands-on training in bookkeeping, sales and purchase entries, receipts, payments, and journal vouchers.
* Demonstrate practical accounting workflows using real-world business scenarios.
* Help students understand the relationship between theoretical accounting concepts and practical applications.
* Ensure students complete assigned practical exercises within the scheduled time.

B. Accounting Software Training

* Provide hands-on training in TallyPrime, QuickBooks, or other accounting software used by the institution.
* Guide students in company creation, ledger creation, voucher entry, inventory management, and financial reporting.
* Train students in GST-related accounting entries, invoicing, and basic compliance workflows, where applicable.
* Demonstrate payroll processing, bank reconciliation, and other relevant accounting functions.
* Assist students in using MS Excel for accounting calculations, reports, data management, and financial analysis.
* Troubleshoot basic software-related issues and support students during practical sessions.

C. Student Guidance and Support

* Assist students individually with practical assignments and accounting exercises.
* Clarify doubts and explain errors in accounting entries and software operations.
* Monitor student progress and identify areas requiring additional practice.
* Provide guidance to students who need extra support to complete practical tasks.
* Maintain a professional, disciplined, and supportive learning environment.
* Help students develop accuracy, confidence, and efficiency in accounting operations.

D. Lab Management and Administration

* Ensure the accounting lab is organized, functional, and ready for scheduled sessions.
* Check the availability and proper functioning of computers, software, and learning resources.
* Maintain student attendance, practical records, assignment submissions, and performance reports.
* Ensure students follow lab guidelines and use systems and software appropriately.
* Report technical issues, software problems, or equipment requirements to the concerned team.
* Coordinate with the academic team regarding lab schedules, student batches, and practical assessments.

E. Assessment and Performance Monitoring

* Conduct practical tests, assignments, exercises, and skill assessments.
* Evaluate students' accuracy, speed, and understanding of accounting procedures.
* Track assignment completion and maintain practical assessment records.
* Provide constructive feedback and recommend additional practice where necessary.
* Support internal examinations, practical evaluations, and course completion assessments.
* Help students prepare for practical interviews and job-related accounting assessments.

F. Academic Coordination and Employability Support

* Coordinate with classroom faculty to align practical sessions with theoretical lessons.
* Prepare practical worksheets, exercises, sample business transactions, and assessment materials.
* Update lab exercises based on current software features and industry practices.
* Support students in developing job-ready skills for roles such as Accounts Assistant, Junior Accountant, and Accounts Executive.
* Assist with mock interviews and practical demonstrations, where required.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
* M.Com or other relevant postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
* Certifications in TallyPrime, GST, MS Excel, QuickBooks, or other accounting software are desirable.
* Relevant practical accounting experience may be considered alongside academic qualifications.

4. Experience Requirements

* 6 month-1 year of experience in accounting, practical accounting training, lab instruction, or accounting software training is preferred.
* Freshers with strong accounting fundamentals and practical software knowledge may also apply.
* Hands-on experience with accounting entries, bookkeeping, GST-related transactions, and financial reporting is an advantage.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles and procedures.
* Proficiency in TallyPrime and MS Excel; knowledge of other accounting software is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of GST accounting and related workflows.
* Ability to troubleshoot common accounting entry and software errors.
* Good communication and student-handling skills.
* Patience and the ability to explain practical concepts step by step.
* Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to accounting accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple students during lab sessions.
* Willingness to learn new software features and industry practices.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Completion of scheduled practical lab sessions.
* Student performance in practical assessments.
* Accuracy and completion rate of accounting lab assignments.
* Student progress in accounting software proficiency.
* Student feedback and satisfaction.
* Maintenance of attendance, assessment, and lab records.
* Effective utilization and maintenance of lab facilities.
* Timely resolution of student doubts and practical learning issues.
* Student readiness for entry-level accounting roles.

7. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be practical, detail-oriented, approachable, and passionate about helping students develop accounting skills. They should be able to demonstrate accounting procedures clearly, identify common mistakes, and guide students towards accurate and efficient use of accounting software.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a computer lab environment and committed to helping students achieve practical competence and employment readiness.

8. What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
* Opportunities for professional development and software certification.
* A supportive academic and training environment.
* Opportunities to contribute to practical curriculum development.
* Career growth in accounting education and professional training.

9. How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume to **catalystthrissur@gmail.com**

**Join our team and help students transform accounting knowledge into practical, industry-ready skills.**

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month
